subject.title: feat(cron): emit session.maintenance.pruned diagnostic event on reaper pruning

question: Should OpenClaw adopt session.maintenance.pruned and its OpenTelemetry and Prometheus metric names as a permanent supported diagnostics contract?
rationale: The code can implement the event mechanically, but automation cannot decide whether this additive operator-facing event and metric naming should become a long-lived compatibility surface.

options.title: Approve after exporter proof
options.body: Accept the proposed count-only contract once a real Gateway prune visibly produces the documented Prometheus or OTLP metric.

options.title: Keep log-only behavior
options.body: Decline the new permanent telemetry surface and continue relying on the existing structured text log for reaper observability.

recommendation.title: Approve after exporter proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed count-only contract once a real Gateway prune visibly produces the documented Prometheus or OTLP metric.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest available history signal is recent cron and session-derived scheduling work adjacent to the reaper path.
